responsibility: This header defines the resources structure and public APIs for GCC’s late RTL resource analysis. It models memory, volatile memory, condition-code, and hard-register requirements, defines the mark_resource_type selector for whether CALL effects are considered, and declares helpers for marking referenced/set resources, computing target live registers, maintaining cached branch-target information, and initializing or freeing the analysis state used by reorg and related passes.
same_name_distinction: Defines the resources structure, mark_resource_type enum, and public analysis routines used by late RTL reorg code; resource.cc performs the actual resource and liveness computations.
